title: EigDiff: Eigensample Diffusion - or how to significantly reduce training dataset size with marginal performance variation?
title_zh: EigDiff：特征样本扩散——或者如何以极小的性能波动大幅缩减训练数据集规模？

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的方法EigDiff，通过特征样本扩散显著减小训练数据集规模，同时保持模型性能。 Diffusion models are notoriously expensive to train, requiring large-scale datasets to learn how to gradually reverse the noise from images over multiple small denoising steps. Current approaches focus on distilling the number of diffusion steps, neglecting potential redundancies of the training data. In this paper, we explore the potential of harnessing eigensamples to train diffusion models on significantly smaller datasets, while preserving model performance. To mitigate the sensitivity to affine transformations of eigenimages, we harness the latent space of a pre-trained CLIP model. We next compute latent eigenvectors by performing principal component analysis (PCA) in CLIP space. Further, we employ eigenvectors as reference points to guide the selection of a representative training set comprising comprising both exemplars (images whose embeddings are closest to eigenvectors) and diverse images. Our comprehensive experiments with different diffusion models applied on multiple datasets indicate that our approach (EigDiff) can reduce training data by up to 14x and accelerate subset selection by up to 1607x, with marginal performance differences.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的方法EigDiff，通过特征样本扩散显著减小训练数据集规模，同时保持模型性能。扩散模型的训练成本极高，需要大规模数据集来学习如何在多个小的去噪步骤中逐步逆转图像中的噪声。 现有方法专注于蒸馏扩散步数，而忽视了训练数据中潜在的冗余。 在本文中，我们探索了利用特征样本在显著更小的数据集上训练扩散模型的潜力，同时保持模型性能。 为了缓解特征图像对仿射变换的敏感性，我们利用了预训练CLIP模型的潜在空间。 接下来，我们通过在CLIP空间中执行主成分分析（PCA）来计算潜在特征向量。 此外，我们将特征向量用作参考点，以指导选择一个由样本代表（即嵌入与特征向量最接近的图像）和多样化图像组成的代表性训练集。 我们在不同扩散模型和多个数据集上进行的全面实验表明，我们的方法（EigDiff）可以将训练数据最多减少14倍，并将子集选择速度最多提升1607倍，而性能差异微乎其微。
